newsitem.title: CHINA: China to set up new farm insurance system.
newsitem.headline: China to set up new farm insurance system.

text.p: China plans to set up a new insurance system to protect its agricultural sector, which is huge but vulnerable to natural calamities, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Existing insurance companies are increasingly reluctant to sell policies to farmers due to the vulnerability of farm production to natural disasters such as floods and drought, it quoted Duan Xiaoxing, deputy director of the State Council, or cabinet, Inter-Department Coordinative Group for Rural Financial Reforms, as saying in an interview.
Many domestic farm insurers were running at a loss and this would further hamper the development of China's fledgling insurance industry if no solutions were found, he said.
Methods for founding a new farming insurance network were still under consideration, he said.
However, the new agricultural insurers were expected to be run locally and adopt a cooperative system in terms of administration and management, he said.
Chinese insurers pay out hundreds of millions of dollars in compensation each year after China's annual summer season of floods and droughts.
